question: KCC loan par kitna subsidy milta hai?
answer: The interest subvention rate for the financial year 2025-26 is 1.50%, with an additional 3% subvention for farmers repaying on time.
evidence_quote: Rate of Interest Subvention to Lending Institutions 2025-26 7% 1.50% (ii) An additional interest subvention of 3% per annum will be provided to such of those farmers repaying in time

question: What happens to the interest rate on restructured loans for farmers affected by natural calamities after the first year?
answer: Restructured loans for farmers affected by natural calamities will attract the normal rate of interest from the second year onwards.
evidence_quote: Such restructured loans will attract normal rate of interest from the second year onwards.
